description: The historic station is known for its red-brick facade and central clock tower. Now part of the railway cultural park, it is a place to explore Taichung’s railway heritage beside the modern station.
descriptionZh: 以紅磚立面與中央鐘塔為特色的歷史車站，如今是鐵道文化園區的一部分。可以在新舊車站並存的景色中，認識臺中的鐵道記憶。
officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Taichung Station Railway Cultural Park

location.address: No. 1, Sec. 1, Taiwan Blvd., Central Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市中區臺灣大道一段1號

description: A historic city park with a lake, arched bridges and the distinctive Mid-Lake Pavilion. Walk its shaded paths and see a landmark that has long represented Taichung.
descriptionZh: 擁有湖泊、拱橋與代表性湖心亭的歷史公園。沿著綠蔭步道散步，看看長久以來象徵臺中的城市地標。
officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Taichung Park

location.address: No. 65, Sec. 1, Shuangshi Rd., North Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市北區雙十路一段65號

description: A former eye clinic near the station, restored as a red-brick destination for pastries and ice cream. Look for the preserved facade and archway, then explore its tall, bookcase-lined interior.
descriptionZh: 鄰近車站的舊眼科診所，修復後成為以糕點與冰淇淋聞名的紅磚建築。可以欣賞保留下來的立面與牌樓，再走進挑高、排列木書架的室內空間。
officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Miyahara

location.address: No. 20, Zhongshan Rd., Central Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan

description: A science museum with galleries about life, human cultures and the environment, plus a botanical garden. Discover dinosaur exhibits and Taiwan's native plants at a major destination for learning about the natural world.
officialSourceTitle: National Museum of Natural Science — Galleries

location.address: No. 1, Guanqian Rd., North Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan

descriptionZh: 結合生命、人類文化、環境等主題展區與植物園的科學博物館。從恐龍展示到臺灣原生植物，是認識自然世界的重要去處。

officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Calligraphy Greenway

location.address: Xiangshang N. Rd., West Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市西區向上北路一帶

description: A green cultural corridor linking the science museum, Civic Square and the fine-arts district. Walk the promenade, spend time in the square, and explore nearby shops around Park Lane by CMP.
descriptionZh: 串連科學博物館、市民廣場與美術街區的綠色文化廊道。可以漫步草悟道、在廣場停留，也能走訪勤美誠品綠園道周邊的小店。

description: Former auditing-office dormitories now house independent shops and creative studios. Wander the compact lanes to see how old housing has become a home for young entrepreneurs and local design.
descriptionZh: 原本的審計處員工宿舍，如今聚集獨立小店與創意工作室。走進小巧的巷弄，看看老宿舍如何成為青年創業與在地設計的空間。
officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Shen Ji New Village

location.address: Ln. 368, Minsheng Rd., West Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan

nameEn: National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts
description: A national art museum focused on modern and contemporary Taiwanese art. Explore its exhibitions and outdoor sculpture park for a closer look at Taiwan's artists and visual culture.
officialSourceTitle: National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts — Overview

location.address: No. 2, Sec. 1, Wuquan W. Rd., West Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市西區五權西路一段2號

descriptionZh: 以臺灣現代與當代藝術為重點的國立美術館。可以參觀展覽、漫步戶外雕塑園區，認識臺灣藝術家與視覺文化。

description: A lively shopping and food district around Feng Chia University, with snack stalls, clothing shops and busy lanes. Come for Taichung’s street-food culture and evening market atmosphere.
descriptionZh: 圍繞逢甲大學發展的熱鬧商圈，巷弄中聚集小吃攤、服飾店與逛街人潮。適合認識臺中的街頭飲食文化與夜市氣氛。
officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Fengchia Night Market

location.address: Around Feng Chia University, Xitun Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市西屯區逢甲大學周邊

description: A sunken urban green space beside Taiwan Boulevard, with a lake, planted slopes and an observation bridge. Its paths offer a quieter walk among the surrounding city buildings.
descriptionZh: 位於臺灣大道旁的下凹式城市綠地，設有湖泊、植栽坡地與觀景橋。沿著步道走走，在都市建築之間感受較安靜的綠意。
officialSourceTitle: Taichung Tourism and Travel Bureau — Maple Garden

location.address: Intersection of Shizheng N. 7th Rd. and Sec. 3, Henan Rd., Xitun Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市西屯區市政北七路與河南路三段路口

description: A performing arts venue designed by architect Toyo Ito, known for flowing curved walls and connected sound-cave spaces. Visit for its architecture, public spaces and performances.

location.address: No. 101, Sec. 2, Huilai Rd., Xitun Dist., Taichung City, Taiwan
location.addressZh: 臺中市西屯區惠來路二段101號

descriptionZh: 由建築師伊東豊雄設計的表演藝術場館，以流動曲牆與相互串連的「美聲涵洞」空間聞名。可以欣賞建築、逛逛公共空間，或安排一場演出。

description: Visit this temple in Nantun’s Wanhe precinct, step inside its hall and meet the host. This stop has no gym battle or badge.
descriptionZh: 走訪南屯萬和宮街廓的廟宇，進入大廳與接待員交談。這個參訪地點沒有道館對戰或徽章。

descriptionZh: 走訪南屯萬和宮街廓的廟宇，進入大廳與接待員交談。這個參訪地點沒有道館對戰或徽章。
